claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation, reassessing arterial blood gases.
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring via arterial line and central venous pressure, with titration of vasoactive infusions (phenylephrine, nitroglycerin) to maintain MAP goals.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly glucose checks and titration to maintain glycemic control.
Continue temporary pacemaker with rate/sensitivity settings reviewed and monitored for capture and sensing.
Continue scheduled antibiotics (cefazolin, vancomycin) and reassess need based on cultures and clinical course.
Reassess and manage severe pain with multimodal analgesia, monitoring response and respiratory status.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium) and renal function, replacing as needed.
Perform daily sedation interruption/lightening trial and assess readiness for ventilator weaning given improving mentation.
Maintain VTE prophylaxis and continue aspirin/statin for cardiovascular secondary prevention.
Continue aspiration precautions, oral care, and mobility/positioning to reduce complications.
